name: Cultist: Dark Channeler extends Psychic Suppression and Eldritch Devastation natively (#1789)
contract: 301008 has two ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects, both MiscValue=1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION). Effect0 EffectBasePoints=999/DieSides=1 gives +1000 ms (classmask dword1=8388608, bit23); effect1 EffectBasePoints=1999/DieSides=1 gives +2000 ms (classmask dword0=64, bit6) (+1 per SpellInfo.cpp:489). Verified against Spell.dbc: 800432 'Psychic Suppression' (dword1=8388608, bit23 set, DurationIndex=28, base 5000 ms) and 802727 'Eldritch Devastation' (dword0=64, bit6 set, DurationIndex=35, base 4000 ms) both have finite base durations, so Player::IsAffectedBySpellmod's permanent-duration guard (Player.cpp:10202) never fires: 5000+1000=6000 ms and 4000+2000=6000 ms, matching the tooltip's '+1 sec' and '+2 sec' exactly. No script needed.
